name: Method / Procedure
purpose: Represent reusable authored methods and procedures, immutable editions, applicability and adopter-owned adoption records without treating publication or adoption as execution.

owns: procedure identity and ordered instruction content
immutable released editions and errata lineage
adopter-owned adoption records and effective dates
delegates: operational process definitions and execution to WM-ACT-003
competence and credential identity to their external masters
standard identity and legal effect to external authorities
excludes: process instances work items or execution outcomes

relations.purpose: Allow navigation to processes that operationalize an adopted edition while the authoritative link remains process-owned.

operations.effect: Issue an immutable edition or erratum with digest and lineage.
Issue a successor while preserving the predecessor.
Create an adopter-owned record with an effective date and authority.
End local applicability without altering the published edition.

invariants: A released edition is immutable and content-addressed.
Correction creates an erratum or successor edition and never edits released text in place.
Adoption takes effect on the adopter-recorded effective date rather than publication date.
An adoption record pins exactly one immutable edition.
A procedure is instruction knowledge and never records work performance.
A method states approach and rationale while a procedure states ordered instructions.
Process definitions reference adopted editions without copying their text.
Publishing a new edition never silently re-points an active or completed process.
Standard and competence references do not transfer external mastership.
Wildcard imports do not constitute standards conformance.
holds: Exact Grok review and provider reconciliation are pending.
One frozen no-tools semantic audit of the reconciled candidates is pending.
External notation and standards crosswalks are not conformance claims.
Package conversion and live HTTP/runtime/search/package verification are pending.
